# Step 2.146, the independent review by attack

Reviewed at `be4b2f0d` (lane `lane/2.146-show-as`), against `origin/build/stage-1`. Two
throwaway browser scripts (scripts on, the made-up stand-in, `APP_ENV=test`, the build of
04:24 made after the last code commit) and one guard broken by hand; nothing of them is kept.

No High. Four Medium, six Low.

## 1. A child's name that leaks: none found

- Youth league (`harbor-city`): Sam Rivera set to "removed", Maya Cho to "initials", both in
  Admin → People. On the league's default, on Hidden and on full names, every public answer was
  searched for `Sam`, `Rivera`, `Maya`, `Cho`: the home page, teams, each team page, statistics
  (leaders included), standings, schedule, all five game pages, each game's snapshot
  (`/api/v1/leagues/{id}/games/{game}/snapshot`), each page's served HTML, its `RSC: 1` answer
  and its prefetch answer, the drawn page, and every document, fetch and XHR answer the browser
  got while opening it. 236 answers, 0 hits.
- Adult league (`north-valley`) on full names: Pia set to "removed"; a walk-up
  "Zed Walkington" (no date, no tick) added at the table of the live game
  `…006a00000002`, both scoring. Searched for `Pia` and `Walkington` in the same answers, the
  live game's page before and after the plays, the live stream while plays were sent
  (`latestPlay` came as `playerName: null, jersey: null` for Pia) and the snapshot; then again
  on Hidden. 454 answers, 0 hits. The walk-up reads "Zed W." everywhere (S-136 holds).
- The rosters address is staff only (a visitor gets 401). To the scorekeeper Pia is
  `firstName: "", lastName: ""` with her number 9 (R-33); the walk-up is "Zed W.".

## 2. Who may change: the guards hold

- The "Save Show as" server action captured from the owner's page and posted by hand with each
  made-up role in the draft league (`quiet-pines`, where the staff roles are): scorekeeper,
  scheduler, editor, club admin, program scheduler 403; another league's admin, coach, team
  coach, stranger 404; registrar 200 and saved (R-23 says admin or registrar); admin and owner
  then `changed-since-read`. Nothing else changed the record.
- `?ticked=grown` read by every role: only the owner gets the page (no birth date in it but the
  date box's own `min` and today); every other role 403, the `RSC: 1` answers 307.
- Broken by hand: the read-only guard of `mayRecordRequest`
  (`packages/core/src/modules/people/commands/set-name-request.ts:59`) is caught by two tests
  of `set-name-request.test.ts` (archived, suspended). Restored.
- Not proved here: a hand-made "show more" post in an archived or suspended league. The made-up
  `old-meadow` People list has no record to open (the script timed out finding one); the command
  guard above is what stands, and its tests catch its removal.

## 3. Rows saved before this step

- `people.visibility` only ever holds `none`, `initials`, `removed`
  (`supabase/migrations/0008_people_teams_rosters.sql:76`): no old value to misread; `none`
  shows no "Show as" words (`teams-area/roster-name.ts:26`).
- Walk-ups already in games: names are worked out at read time, so no final game, play,
  number or stored row changes; an adult league's final games on full names now show their
  walk-ups as "Zed W." (Low 5). The "has a recorded child" read passes `recordedOnly`
  (`packages/database/src/queries/has-recorded-child.ts:16`), and the S-109 put-back reads only
  that (`put-back-on-first-child.ts:103`): a walk-up mid-game puts nothing back.

## 4. The numbers

- R-17: the removed child's statistics line keeps its own numbers (`show-as-test` proves it,
  builder 3); leaders word it through the same `playerNameText`.
- "Two current places on one team, picked by text order" cannot happen in the database: one
  current place per person and team is a unique index (`0008_people_teams_rosters.sql:212`).
  Text order still picks among former places only ("9" over "12";
  `packages/database/src/queries/list-player-team-links.ts`). Low 3.
- "Confirmed on … by {name}": the nearest confirmed save of that setting within a minute
  (`apps/web/src/features/settings-area/confirmed-by.ts:20`). It names the wrong person only if
  two confirmed saves fall within the minute and the one nearer the stored moment is not the
  stored one, or the log search's page drops the right entry. Low 4.

## Findings

- **Medium 1 (S-136 takes a choice from an adult league's admin).** A walk-up counts as a child
  for display, but not as a recorded child, so in an adult league with no recorded child the
  parents' confirmation is not offered (`apps/web/src/features/settings-area/privacy-notes.ts:94`)
  and nothing on Privacy says walk-ups are shortened (the "unknown age" line is for youth and
  mixed leagues only, `privacy-notes.ts:62`). The admin's only way to show a walk-up in full is to
  untick each one, with no list of them, and their record says the age is not recorded
  (`people-area/age-on-record.ts`, builder 4's distrust). R-14 (founder): "a starting setting the
  admin can change"; S-21 (Agreed): differences are settings. Proved by reading and by the walk-up
  reading "Zed W." on full names. Mend: count walk-ups for the offer (not for S-109), or a Privacy
  line and a People filter.
- **Medium 2 (S-136 changes R-28 without its row).** R-28 (DECISIONS.md:124) says "with no date
  and no tick the league does not know, as before"; S-136 makes a walk-up a child. The P6 text is
  corrected, the R-28 row is not, and S-136 does not say it changes R-28. The lead's landing
  should write R-28 as a `Change`.
- **Medium 3 (no committed proof of the game page, snapshot and live message).** Plan row 29's
  last part is not built: nothing committed checks a removed child on a game page, its snapshot
  or the live stream. This review's script did (above, 0 hits); `show-as-test` can do the same
  with the live game `…006a00000002` and Pia (`trackedPlayer(3, 4)`).
- **Medium 4 (rows 24 and 27 not built).** The wider R-28 column scan and the two T-81 scans with
  dates (`packages/core/src/modules/name-policy-scan.test.ts:86`,
  `apps/web/src/server/database-names-scan.test.ts`) are untouched. Nothing found leaks today;
  they guard the next change. Can follow landing as its own step, but should be listed in STATUS.
- **Low 1 (the finder's role guard is untested).** Deleting
  `if (input.tickedButGrown && !sensitive) return ok([]);`
  (`packages/core/src/modules/people/commands/list-people.ts:27`) fails no core people test (18
  files, 162 tests); the database test only asks with `sensitive: true`
  (`minor-by-age-sql.test.ts:380`). The page gate keeps the roles tried out today.
- **Low 2 (S-134 against S-34 and R-24's rows).** S-34 says "#12 everywhere", R-24 "like #12";
  the roster now reads "Name not shown" with the number in its column. Defensible (the number is
  shown once); the lead should word S-34 and R-24 to match. No admin choice lost.
- **Low 3** former roster places' number by text order (above).
- **Low 4** the confirmer matched by time (above).
- **Low 5 (retroactive display).** On full names, an adult league's earlier games now show walk-ups
  by first name and last initial; the scorer's own screen too, the moment a full name is typed
  (R-33 holds). The founder should hear it once.
- **Low 6 (the form offers "initials" to anyone).** The panel offers all three choices in a live
  league and leaves "initials-not-offered" (R-25) to the command; not tried in a browser.

## The decisions (T-513, T-516, T-517, S-134, S-135, S-136)

T-513, T-516, T-517 and S-135 take nothing from an admin. S-134 is wording (Low 2). S-136 is
the careful reading for a child, but as built it removes the league-wide switch from an adult
league without recorded children (Medium 1) and changes R-28 unsaid (Medium 2). There is no
T-514 or T-515 file.

## Not built in the plan, and whether it matters before landing

- Rows 24 and 27 (Medium 4): may follow landing if listed.
- Row 29's game page and snapshot in a browser (Medium 3): add before landing, small.
- The whole-name question and `?ticked=grown` in a browser: not before landing.
- Medium 1 wants the lead's call before landing: it is a product effect on every adult league.
